cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 2 retained. Immutable attempt 7152874 forces.csv covers 30000 steps to t=300; t≥200 mean Cd 1.0570129, Cl range -0.0406881–0.0420201, upcrossings 213.7033, 231.3543, 248.8606, 266.1942, 283.3729 yield periods 17.18–17.65 and frequency about 0.057, consistent with report estimate St≈0.055 under its normalization. Accepted PDF p17 has actual wake velocity/pressure contours, correcting old false missing-contour note, but startup Cd≈28.8 compresses the complete force plot and neither late Cd nor Cl oscillation is readable; no qualifying separate late plot identified, so floor remains 2. More critically, report.tex:304–307 claims BDF2 but the run-version and curated solver.cpp:666–673,1435–1437 compute 1.5(U−Un)+0.5(U−Unm1), not BDF2; transient is of uncertain physics/temporal accuracy. Inner ratio is for the implemented total residual, not the required BDF2 residual; actual strict BDF2 misses cannot be inferred. DQ6 is under review.
